persists.proof: FOR THE PLUGIN STORE, and this contradicts a coverage row -- see findings B5-DIM-04. snapshotFamilyCoverage.ts declares { storeKey:'dimension', status:'persisted', snapshotKey:'annotations' }, but the snapshot's dimensions array is produced by ProjectSerializer.ts:1793-1798 from annotationStore.serialize(), which returns Array.from(this._dims.values()) (plugins/annotations/src/subsystem/AnnotationStore.ts:276-282). The only writer of _dims is annotationStore.addDimension, whose sole production call site is plugins/annotations/src/AnnotationManager.ts:585. Nothing copies ctx.stores.dimension into _dims, and readPluginStore('dimension') is never called. A record created by dimension.create is destroyed on reload.
